holidays.name: World Population Day
holidays.description: A day to reflect on how many humans are sharing this one spinning rock, and to ponder everything from crowded elevators to the global line for brunch.
holidays.origin: Established by the United Nations Development Programme's Governing Council in 1989, inspired by the public interest in Five Billion Day on July 11, 1987, when the world's population was estimated to reach five billion.
holidays.funFact: The world population has more than doubled since 1960 and passed 8 billion in November 2022.

holidays.name: National Slurpee Day (7-Eleven Day)
holidays.description: Brain-freeze enthusiasts rejoice! Since the date is 7/11, 7-Eleven stores celebrate by giving away free small Slurpees to customers, turning the date into a frosty pilgrimage.
holidays.origin: 7-Eleven began celebrating its birthday with free Slurpees on 7/11 in 2002, tying the brand name to the calendar date. The chain itself dates to 1927 in Dallas, Texas.
holidays.funFact: The Slurpee was reportedly inspired by a broken soft-serve machine in a Kansas Dairy Queen, where owner Omar Knedlik found that partially frozen bottled soda was a hit.

holidays.name: Cheer Up the Lonely Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to reaching out to anyone who might be feeling isolated, whether with a phone call, a note, a visit, or a surprise cupcake.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance that grew through grassroots and social media promotion, encouraging people to brighten the day of someone who is lonely.
holidays.funFact: Researchers have found that chronic loneliness can affect health in ways comparable to smoking up to 15 cigarettes a day, which makes a friendly phone call surprisingly powerful.

holidays.name: All American Pet Photo Day
holidays.description: Pet owners are encouraged to get out their cameras and capture their dogs, cats, hamsters, and lizards in their most photogenic poses, preferably before they knock something off a shelf.
holidays.origin: An unofficial pet-themed observance that spread through pet-lover communities and social media, celebrating the animals who rule our camera rolls.
holidays.funFact: Surveys regularly find that many pet owners have more photos of their pets on their phones than of their friends or family.

holidays.name: Mojito Day
holidays.description: A day to raise a glass of minty, lime-splashed rum goodness and muddle your way into summer bliss, with a non-alcoholic virgin version for those who prefer it.
holidays.origin: An informal food and drink observance celebrating the classic Cuban cocktail, which has roots in Havana and is long associated with Cuban culture.
holidays.funFact: The mojito is said to be a favorite of author Ernest Hemingway, who allegedly drank them at La Bodeguita del Medio in Havana.
